doc.title: No published reliance route
doc.description: The abridged route's trusted regulators, age limit and sameness rule are local practice. No in-force source describes them, so the route is labelled proposed.

global_examples.quote: the reliance decision should be based on the sameness of the product

doc.readiness_dimension: AI policy and policy for AI
doc.suggested_next_step: Review with the authority's legal team.

doc.title: No in-force rule on child-resistant closures for oral liquids
doc.description: PACK-01 found no in-force source that sets a child-resistant closure requirement for oral liquids. Each such case needs a person to decide.

global_examples.quote: closures should be appropriate to the product and its intended users

doc.suggested_next_step: Ask whether a national requirement exists, or adopt a reference standard.

doc.title: No rule on when a foreign change triggers re-review
doc.description: No in-force source sets a trigger, a timeline or a responsible role for re-reviewing a licence after a foreign change.

global_examples.quote: reliance does not remove the responsibility of the relying authority

doc.readiness_dimension: AI policy and policy for AI
doc.suggested_next_step: Draft a re-review procedure with the authority.
doc.review_note: Confirmed with the case management team. Six re-reviews were opened ad hoc this quarter.
